🎥🎬: After Life (2019)

Tony Johnson is a newspaper journalist whose world falls apart after the death of his beloved wife, Lisa. Unable to cope with the loss, he becomes bitter, cynical, and increasingly hostile toward everyone around him. Convinced that life has nothing left to offer, Tony decides to live without caring about the consequences of his actions, believing he has nothing left to lose.

But his plan to push everyone away becomes complicated when the people around him refuse to give up on him. From his supportive colleagues at the local newspaper to his quirky friends and unexpected connections, Tony slowly discovers that even the smallest acts of kindness can make a difference. Despite his sarcastic attitude and constant attempts to sabotage his relationships, those around him continue trying to bring some happiness back into his life.

As Tony navigates grief, loneliness, friendship, and the possibility of finding happiness again, he begins to understand that moving forward doesn’t mean forgetting the person he lost. Created by and starring Ricky Gervais, After Life is a touching blend of dark comedy and emotional storytelling about love, loss, and learning to live again.
